main.summary: Represents a lightweight cursor candidate for stale transfer-session cleanup, ordered by activity time and session identifier.

property.name: LastActivity
property.summary: Gets the server-observed activity time used to order and filter cleanup candidates.

property.name: ItemID
property.summary: Gets the associated data item identifier used to acquire the mutation lock.

property.name: CatalogName
property.summary: Gets the catalog that owns the transfer session.
